# Code of Conduct

All employees are expected to treat colleagues, clients, and partners with respect regardless of
role, background, or seniority. Harassment, discrimination, and retaliation of any kind are
prohibited and can be reported confidentially via the Ethics Hotline (ethics@alderbrooksystems.example
or the anonymous web form linked on the intranet home page).

Conflicts of interest (e.g., financial interest in a vendor or competitor) must be disclosed to
your manager and Legal within 5 business days of becoming aware of them.

Violations are investigated by HR and Legal jointly and may result in disciplinary action up to
termination.
